items.html: And the explanation of these words is this. For behold, it is known what is said in the Sha'ar HaPesukim in the portion Vayetze, on the verse 'And Rachel stole the teraphim,' and on the verse 'the reward of humility is the fear of the Lord,' and see there very well, for there it is explained how the feet of Leah and her heels enter and clothe within the Keter of Rachel, and this whole place is in the middle third of the Tifferet of ZA.
